activeSubscriptions.method: live feature-stream subscriptions, each with a reader draining it, held for the steady-state window and counted by GET /api/v1/admin/streaming/features/sessions

alertEvaluationsPerSecond.reason: the alert pipeline refuses to start unless tenant-context resolution is disabled (its evaluation and delivery stores are instance-wide), and with resolution disabled the OGC API Features item query the declared envelope is served through answers 403 'Tenant context is required to query collection items'; driving the declared alert rate and serving the declared envelope are mutually exclusive on this candidate, so the rate is declared, not claimed

concurrentVirtualUsers.method: NBomber soak profile total virtual users (LoadTestProfile.Soak.TotalVirtualUsers)

featuresPerLayer.method: per-layer returnCountOnly=true query against the serving API

gpQueueDepth.method: geoprocessing queue exercised for the whole steady-state window; the declared depth is an operating bound and the observed maximum stayed within it
gpQueueDepth.note: with the declared single worker, execution admission answers 503 'Global active job limit reached (1/1)' to a submission arriving while a job runs, so the queue does not grow towards the declared bound through the GPServer submit path; the bound was respected but not filled

gpWorkers.method: ExecutionAdmission:MaxConcurrentJobsGlobal configured on the substrate, confirmed by the maximum number of concurrently executing jobs observed during steady state

maximumFeaturePayloadBytes.method: POST of a declared-maximum-size feature payload was not rejected by a payload-size limit

tenants.method: capability manifest: scope.tenantSource=Default with admin.multi-tenancy unavailable => a single-tenant deployment

measurement.loadStatisticsError: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/home/runner/work/_temp/load-stats.json'

availability.method: served/attempted ratio of an independent 1 Hz FeatureServer query probe, sampled across the steady-state window (separate from the load harness's own counters)

errorRate.detail: load statistics carry no request counts
errorRate.method: failed/total requests reported by the NBomber soak run across every scenario

p95LatencyMs.detail: at least one scenario reported no percentile latency
p95LatencyMs.method: worst-scenario p95 latency across the soak profile's scenarios — the same worst-scenario reading the frozen limit was taken from

p99LatencyMs.detail: at least one scenario reported no percentile latency
p99LatencyMs.method: worst-scenario p99 latency across the soak profile's scenarios — the same worst-scenario reading the frozen limit was taken from

queueAgeSeconds.method: maximum age reached by a queued geoprocessing job before the declared single worker started it, measured client-side once per second across the steady-state window

recoveryTimeSeconds.method: seconds from injecting a server-process fault (container restart) until the deployment served a feature query again; run after the steady-state window so the frozen availability budget is not spent on a deliberate outage

saturationRatio.method: peak connection-pool utilisation reported by the server's own /monitoring/metrics/connection-pool snapshot during the steady-state window; a sample without utilisation data invalidates the signal

throughputRps.detail: load statistics carry no successful-request count or run duration
throughputRps.method: successful requests divided by the full run duration (ramp-up + steady state + ramp-down), the same aggregate the frozen throughput floor was derived from in docs/CAPACITY-ENVELOPE-2026.1.md

signatureFormat: sigstore DSSE signature over the in-toto provenance statement whose subject is sha256:26ee9bc3dca2f15882ba1a781bfd143c6f41a9c6bc5ec8f3d03016abae95d123 — the canonical JSON of this receipt without its signature members

substrate.note: docker compose on a GitHub-hosted runner: PostGIS + Redis + the candidate server image, Production startup policy. No cloud substrate is exercised; the published capacity claim is bounded to this topology.
